Redesign 3 admin pages for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app. Read each current file first before rewriting.

## Task 1: Redesign Widget Customizer (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`)

Read the current file first (~815 lines). Keep the existing loader and action logic.

**Layout redesign - side-by-side:**
- Use `Layout` with two sections: main settings (left, default section) + sticky preview (right, `variant="oneThird"`)
- Settings organized in Cards:

**Card 1: Display Mode**
- 3 option cards (popup/inline/both) in InlineGrid — each with name, brief description, and visual indicator of which is selected (highlighted border/background)

**Card 2: Trigger Style** 
- 3 options (button/link/tab) with Select or visual cards

**Card 3: Position**
- 4 options (bottom-right/bottom-left/top-right/top-left) with Select

**Card 4: Colors**
- Color inputs in a clean 2-column grid using InlineGrid:
  - Primary color, Background color, Text color, Success color, Error color
  - Each with label and color input (native input type="color" + hex text field)

**Card 5: Border & Spacing**
- Border radius with RangeSlider (0-24)

**Card 6: Text Content**
- TextField for: heading, placeholder, buttonText, successMessage, errorMessage

**Card 7: Recommender**
- Checkbox: Show size recommender

**Card 8: Custom CSS**
- TextField with multiline for custom CSS, with helper text warning about supported CSS

**Preview panel (right side):**
- Sticky positioned
- A visual mock of the widget showing:
  - Button/trigger with the configured text and primary color
  - A simplified popup preview box showing heading, a sample table, and the recommender section
  - Apply the configured colors as inline styles
  - Device toggle: "Desktop" / "Mobile" buttons that change preview width
- "Reset to defaults" button at bottom of preview

**Save button**: Sticky at bottom or in Page primaryAction

## Task 2: Redesign Analytics Dashboard (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.analytics.tsx`)

Read the current file first (~815 lines). 

**Key change**: The current loader reimplements analytics queries inline. Replace with imports from `~/lib/analytics.server` which has better helpers that are currently UNUSED:
```typescript
// Available from ~/lib/analytics.server:
getAnalyticsSummary(shop, from, to) → { views, clicks, recommendations, conversions, dismissals }
getConversionFunnel(shop, from, to) → { viewToClick, clickToRecommend, recommendToConvert }
getTopCharts(shop, from, to, limit) → Array<{ chartId, chartName, views }>
getDailyTrend(shop, from, to) → Array<{ date, views, clicks, recommendations, conversions }>
```

Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/lib/analytics.server.ts` to understand the exact signatures.

**Loader redesign:**
- Keep date range parsing (preset + custom from/to)
- Keep plan gate check
- Use the analytics.server helpers instead of inline queries
- Also query previous period for trend comparison

**Component redesign:**
- **Date range bar**: Preset buttons (7d/30d/90d) + custom date inputs in InlineStack
- **Stats row**: 4 StatCard components (import from `../components/StatCard`):
  - Chart Views, Clicks, AI Recommendations, Conversions
  - Each with trend indicator vs previous period
- **Daily Trend Chart**: Use BarChart component (import from `../components/BarChart`)
  - Show daily views as bars
  - Height ~250px
- **Conversion Funnel**: Use FunnelBar component (import from `../components/FunnelBar`)
  - Steps: Views → Clicks → Recommendations → Conversions
- **Top Charts**: Leaderboard card showing top 5 charts by views
  - Each row: rank number, chart name (clickable), view count, horizontal bar indicator
- **Export button**: Button that generates CSV from current data and triggers download
- **Plan gate**: If user doesn't have analytics feature, show PlanGate component instead of data

**Important**: Import StatCard, BarChart, FunnelBar, PlanGate from `../components` (they will be created by another agent, just import them)

## Task 3: Redesign AI Recommender (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.recommender.tsx`)

Read the current file first (~815 lines). Keep existing loader and action logic.

**Component redesign:**
- **Plan gate**: If plan doesn't include AI recommender, show PlanGate component at top
- **Activation card**: Large toggle card at top
  - Big "AI Size Recommender" heading with status Badge (Enabled/Disabled)
  - Toggle button: "Enable" / "Disable"  
  - Brief description of what it does

- **How it works section** (Collapsible or always-visible):
  - 3-step explanation:
    1. "Customer enters height, weight, and body type"
    2. "Our algorithm estimates body measurements"
    3. "We match against your size chart data for the best fit"

- **Body type configuration**: 
  - Each body type as a selectable card with:
    - Name (Slim, Regular, Athletic, Plus, Petite)
    - Simple SVG silhouette icon for each (create small inline SVG paths — just basic body outline shapes, 5 variations)
    - Checkbox to enable/disable
  - Use InlineGrid columns={5} for the body type cards

- **Fit preferences card**:
  - "Between sizes" handling: Select (recommend up / recommend down / show both)
  - Algorithm: Select (basic / advanced) — only available on Pro plan

- **Test Interface card**:
  - Form: Height, Weight, Unit (metric/imperial), Gender, Body Type — all as clean form fields
  - "Get Recommendation" button
  - Results display: Recommended size (large text), confidence percentage, alternative sizes
  - Show which chart was used for the test

- **Active Charts card**: List which charts are active and available for recommendations

**Important constraints for ALL 3 files:**
- Import from `@shopify/polaris` — React components (Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Badge, Button, Box, etc.)
- TypeScript strict — no `any` types
- `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of every loader
- All DB queries scoped by `{ shop }`
- Use `useAppBridge()` for toasts
- Use `useFetcher()` for form submissions
- Use `useNavigate()` for navigation
- React Router 7 (NOT Remix) — imports from `react-router`

Zero errors. Here is a summary of every file changed and the decisions made.

---

## What was built

### Task 1 — Widget Customizer (`app/routes/app.widget.tsx`)

The page is now a true side-by-side layout using `Layout` + `Layout.Section variant="oneThird"`.

**Settings column (left):**
- Card 1 Display Mode — reused the existing selection-card pattern, converted to a new generic `SelectCards` component that accepts any set of options, renders a responsive CSS grid, and applies the highlighted-border selected state
- Card 2 Trigger Style — same `SelectCards` component with the three trigger options
- Card 3 Popup Position — shown only when `displayMode` is popup or both; uses a plain `Select` for the four position options
- Card 4 Colors — new `ColorField` component (color swatch + hex `TextField` in one row, no wrapping `Card` shell) rendered in `InlineGrid columns={2}`
- Card 5 Border & Spacing — `RangeSlider` + preset swatch row
- Card 6 Text Content — heading/button/placeholder in a 2-column grid, success/error messages below with `helpText`
- Card 7 AI Recommender — `Checkbox` with `helpText` and a conditional success badge
- Card 8 Custom CSS — `TextField multiline` with helper text

**Preview column (right, sticky):**
- `position: sticky; top: 64px` wraps the preview card so it stays visible while scrolling settings
- Desktop / Mobile toggle buttons change `maxWidth` of the inner preview (420px vs 320px) with a CSS transition
- Active-config badges (displayMode, triggerType, position, AI state) sit below the toggle
- "Reset to defaults" button at the bottom resets local state to `DEFAULTS` constant (no server round-trip)

### Task 2 — Analytics Dashboard (`app/routes/app.analytics.tsx`)

**Loader:** replaced all inline `db.*` queries with calls to the four analytics server helpers:
- `getAnalyticsSummary` for current and previous period
- `getConversionFunnel` for rate data
- `getTopCharts` for the leaderboard (limit 5)
- `getDailyTrend` for the bar chart data

The previous-period range is computed from the same duration shifted back by exactly `rangeMs` milliseconds so trend comparisons are always apples-to-apples.

**Component changes:**
- `StatCard` — shows value, and if `prevValue > 0`, calculates `%` delta and renders it in success/critical tone
- `BarChart` — now 200px tall, groups into weekly buckets when `> 30` data points, uses `DailyDataPoint` (the type from `analytics.server.ts`) directly
- `FunnelStep` — replaces the old `FunnelBar` + separate row, combines label + count + badge + bar in one component
- `TopChartsLeaderboard` — leaderboard rows with rank circle, clickable chart name, view count, and a proportional indicator bar
- Date range bar — preset buttons + custom `from/to` date inputs with an Apply button, export CSV button that builds a local Blob and triggers download
- Plan gate — kept as before but moved into a cleaner card grid using `Box` directly instead of nested `Card` inside `Card`

### Task 3 — AI Recommender (`app/routes/app.recommender.tsx`)

All loader and action logic is identical to the original.

**Component changes:**
- Activation card — `headingLg` title + `Badge` status + description text side-by-side with a single Enable/Disable `Button` (tone=critical when enabled)
- How it works — 3 cards using `Box` (not nested `Card`) in a 3-column `InlineGrid`
- Body type configuration — new `BodyTypeCard` component; each card shows an inline SVG silhouette (5 variants: slim, regular, athletic, plus, petite), the label, description, and an On badge when enabled; clicking the whole card toggles it; uses `InlineGrid columns={5}` on md+ screens
- Fit preferences card — combines between-sizes `Select` + algorithm `Select` (plan-gated) in a 2-column grid, then four fit-preference cards in a 4-column grid, with a single "Save preferences" button
- Test Interface — chart/gender/body-type in 3 columns, height/weight in 2 columns, "Get Recommendation" button; result shows recommended size in `headingXl`, confidence badge, alternatives, measurement boxes (3-column grid), and which chart was used
- Active Charts — lists all active charts with status badge and category; empty state with CTA if none exist
- Plan/performance bar — unchanged from original, moved to footer
